title: TrafficProfile
description: The 'data' object of Data/Traffic/TrafficProfile_*.json. Mirrors FLRTrafficProfile (Source/LRTraffic/Public/LRTrafficTypes.h). SI units unless the name says otherwise.

PlayerDriverProfile.description: Driver profile used to predict the player's reaction when the player is a MOBIL follower.

DensityCurve.description: Density over run time (piecewise linear, clamped at both ends).

OncomingDensityFactor.description: Density multiplier of the oncoming lanes (two-way roads).

MaxStepsPerFrame.description: Maximum simulation steps per rendered frame.

SpawnMinGapM.description: Minimum bumper-to-bumper distance around a new vehicle, meters.

WreckLifetimeSeconds.description: Wrecks stay in the simulation as stopped obstacles for this long, seconds.

WreckImpulseScale.description: Wreck impulse as a fraction of (mass x player impact speed).

bDrawFarVehicles.description: Draw the vehicles beyond the actor window with one instanced mesh.

BrakeLightDecelMs2.description: Brake lights turn on above this deceleration, m/s2.

DefaultSpeedLimitKmh.description: Speed limit used when the road gives none, km/h.

DensityPoint.description: Density curve key (FVector2D): X = seconds since the run started, Y = vehicles per km per lane.

Name.description: Unique archetype name (reported in near-miss events and snapshots).

SpeedFactorMin.description: Lower bound of the factor applied to the posted speed limit.

SpeedFactorMax.description: Upper bound of the factor applied to the posted speed limit.

bPreferRightLanes.description: Spawns in the right lanes, extra keep-right bias, never the leftmost lane on roads with 3+ lanes.

DriverProfile.description: Forced driver profile name; empty = weighted random among all profiles.

MassKg.description: Mass of the physics wreck, kilograms.

Colors.description: Paint colors (linear), one picked per vehicle.

CabinLengthFraction.description: Grey-box cabin length as a fraction of the body length.

CabinOffsetFraction.description: Grey-box cabin center offset as a fraction of the body length (+ = front).

LowerBodyHeightFraction.description: Grey-box lower body height as a fraction of the total height.

DriverProfile.description: Driver behavior class (FLRTrafficDriverProfile): IDM and MOBIL parameters.

Weight.description: Relative spawn probability among the profiles not forced by an archetype.

DesiredSpeedFactorMin.description: Lower bound of the desired speed factor.

DesiredSpeedFactorMax.description: Upper bound of the desired speed factor.

TimeHeadwayS.description: IDM safe time headway T, seconds.

KeepRightBiasMs2.description: MOBIL keep-right bias, m/s2 (> 0 favours moving right).

SafeDecelMs2.description: MOBIL safety: maximum deceleration imposed on the new follower, m/s2.

AggressiveEventChance.description: Chance per MOBIL evaluation of an announced aggressive lane change.

bSpawnInLeftLanes.description: Spawns preferably in the left lanes.

Windows.description: Longitudinal windows around the player, meters (FLRTrafficWindows).

SimBehindM.description: Vehicles further behind the player are despawned.

SimAheadM.description: Vehicles further ahead of the player are despawned.

MobilBehindM.description: Lane changes are evaluated from this distance behind the player.

MobilAheadM.description: Lane changes are evaluated up to this distance ahead of the player.

SpawnAheadMinM.description: Closest spawn distance ahead of the player.

SpawnAheadMaxM.description: Furthest spawn distance ahead of the player.

SpawnBehindMinM.description: Closest spawn distance behind the player (only while the player is slower than traffic).

SpawnBehindMaxM.description: Furthest spawn distance behind the player.

ActorBehindM.description: Pooled collision actors are used from this distance behind the player.

ActorAheadM.description: Pooled collision actors are used up to this distance ahead of the player.

InitialFillMinAheadM.description: Run reset prefill: closest distance ahead of the player.

InitialClearLaneAheadM.description: Run reset prefill: the lanes occupied by the player stay empty up to this distance.

FairnessTtcSeconds.description: No lane change into the player's lane ahead of the player below this time-to-collision, seconds.

MinGapToPlayerM.description: No lane change into the player's lane closer than this to the player, meters.

bEnforceSolvability.description: Never let every player-direction lane be blocked inside a solvability window.

SolvabilityWindowM.description: Length of the solvability window, meters.

SolvabilityLaneChangeMarginM.description: Extra distance checked ahead when approving a lane change, meters.

AggressiveMinBlinkSeconds.description: Minimum blinker time of aggressive lane changes, seconds.

AggressiveMoveSeconds.description: Lateral move duration of aggressive lane changes, seconds.

LaneChange.description: Lane change timing and MOBIL scheduling (FLRTrafficLaneChangeParams).

BlinkerMinSeconds.description: Minimum blinker time before the lateral motion, seconds.

BlinkerMaxSeconds.description: Maximum blinker time before the lateral motion, seconds.

MoveMinSeconds.description: Minimum duration of the lateral smootherstep motion, seconds.

MoveMaxSeconds.description: Maximum duration of the lateral smootherstep motion, seconds.

MobilIntervalSeconds.description: MOBIL evaluation period of each vehicle, seconds.

CooldownSeconds.description: Minimum time between two lane changes of the same vehicle, seconds.

AbortMoveSeconds.description: Duration of the move back of an aborted lane change, seconds.

MaxPauseSeconds.description: A lane change paused at mid-lane is aborted after this time, seconds.

HeavyKeepRightBiasMs2.description: Extra keep-right bias of archetypes that prefer the right lanes, m/s2.

CloseThresholdM.description: Clearance below which a pass is Close, meters.

VeryCloseThresholdM.description: Clearance below which a pass is VeryClose, meters.

RazorThresholdM.description: Clearance below which a pass is Razor, meters.

MinRelativeSpeedKmh.description: Minimum relative speed for a pass to count, km/h.

ThreadWindowSeconds.description: Window of the thread-the-needle detection, seconds.
